parts.contentText:
1st I tried limping, my go-to remedy. Didn't help much. Knee hurt all the time.
2nd I tried Dr Youtube, who prescribed:
- Tumeric (for inflammation)
- Cherries (for inflammation)
- Getting a cane.

parts.contentHtml: The cane made a big difference, two days of using a cane and my knee didn't start hurting until late in the day, instead of right away.
parts.contentText: The cane made a big difference, two days of using a cane and my knee didn't start hurting until late in the day, instead of right away.

parts.contentHtml: The Tumeric is also an effective excuse for going out to get Parathas.
parts.contentText: The Tumeric is also an effective excuse for going out to get Parathas.

parts.contentHtml: I learned I was doing stairs wrong. Go up stairs one at a time, leading with your good leg. Go down stairs one at a time, leading with your *BAD* leg. Somehow this was not intuitive for me.
parts.contentText: I learned I was doing stairs wrong. Go up stairs one at a time, leading with your good leg. Go down stairs one at a time, leading with your *BAD* leg. Somehow this was not intuitive for me.

parts.contentHtml: I also had to watch several videos on how to walk with a cane so you are actually taking weight off your bad knee. Counter-intuitively you hold the can in the hand opposite the bad knee & the cane moves mirror image to the bad leg.
parts.contentText: I also had to watch several videos on how to walk with a cane so you are actually taking weight off your bad knee. Counter-intuitively you hold the can in the hand opposite the bad knee & the cane moves mirror image to the bad leg.

parts.contentHtml: Don't copy Dr House on TV, because he walks with a cane wrong. Dr Youtube badmouthed his bad style several times. Real doctors hate Dr Youtube, but Dr Youtube hates TV doctors.
parts.contentText: Don't copy Dr House on TV, because he walks with a cane wrong. Dr Youtube badmouthed his bad style several times. Real doctors hate Dr Youtube, but Dr Youtube hates TV doctors.

parts.contentHtml: Anyhow, this shows the importance of exercise, because if I wasn't a regular runner, when people ask why I have a cane, I'd have to say I was old. Instead I can say, it is a sports injury.
parts.contentText: Anyhow, this shows the importance of exercise, because if I wasn't a regular runner, when people ask why I have a cane, I'd have to say I was old. Instead I can say, it is a sports injury.

parts.contentHtml: Almost a year later - my greatest discovery is the pain generally stays away if I can keep my knees physically warm, i.e. long thermal underwear.
